# IdleScreen

> IdleScreen is a free, MIT-licensed, signed and notarized macOS screen saver with a native companion app. It turns procedural scenes or a live camera into a Metal-rendered field of animated characters. It needs macOS 26 Tahoe or newer and is a universal build for Apple silicon and Intel, from CodesWhat.

Install the signed DMG from the latest release or with Homebrew: `brew install --cask codeswhat/tap/idlescreen`. Camera access is requested only when you choose a camera effect. A separately signed, sandboxed camera agent owns the camera. Frames stay in a local mailbox and aren't sent over the network or written to logs.

## Get it

- [Download the latest release](https://github.com/CodesWhat/idlescreen/releases/latest): signed, notarized DMG
- [Releases](https://github.com/CodesWhat/idlescreen/releases): release notes and checksums
